items.html: And this is what is said: 'the place where the beginning is found, from the Atik' — the place of the beginning of the revelation, which is found and descends from the Atik, where the bone spreads, as I explained. And this is through the hairs of the beard, which are called the Mazal, for through the Mazal the upper bone descends and shines to it. And this is 'that which is illuminated from the Mazal' — it is the radiance of the Hochma that afterward spreads in ZA into thirty-two parts. Or else, in it itself it spreads into thirty-two parts, for behold, the whiteness of the skull too spreads into thirteen parts, as above; and in ZA they become paths.
